about: Baker Bun (in the bakery, the yellow house in Cobble Village) wants a village picnic. Cook a bun, a fruit pie and a honey cake at the oven (recipes in cooking.json) or buy them at the counter, then put them on the picnic blanket by the village pond (east.json entity 'village-picnic'). Setting the picnic out sets the flag 'picnic-ready': the food appears on the blanket and Bun walks over to it (the Bun in the bakery hides, the one at the picnic appears).
title: The Village Picnic

say: {name}! I HAVE A WONDERFUL IDEA: A PICNIC FOR THE WHOLE VILLAGE!
WE NEED A BUN, A FRUIT PIE AND A HONEY CAKE ON THE BLANKET BY THE VILLAGE POND.
COOK THEM AT MY OVEN, OR BUY THEM AT MY COUNTER WITH COINS. THE OVEN SHOWS WHAT EACH TREAT NEEDS.

steps.objective: Bring a bun, a pie and a cake to the picnic blanket ({have} of {need})

village-picnic: (THE BLANKET IS READY. BRING A BUN, A FRUIT PIE AND A HONEY CAKE. YOU HAVE {have} OF {need}.)
baker-bun: A BUN NEEDS WHEAT AND AN EGG. A PIE NEEDS WHEAT AND TWO FRUIT. A CAKE NEEDS WHEAT, TWO EGGS AND HONEY.
NO WHEAT? PICK IT IN THE FIELDS, OR BUY SOME AT MY COUNTER.

say: (YOU SET OUT THE BUN, THE PIE AND THE CAKE. WHAT A FEAST!)

steps.objective: Say hello to {@picnic-bun} at the picnic
say: OH, {name}, IT'S PERFECT! THE BUN IS SO SOFT, AND THE CAKE IS SO SWEET.
YOU ARE A REAL BAKER NOW!

complete.speaker: picnic-bun
say: PLEASE TAKE THESE MUFFINS. THANK YOU FOR THE BEST PICNIC EVER!
